findings.claim: The observed support for coordinate curves is the score-node window [0.0, 0.49] with 50 observed score times; no extrapolation beyond this window is permitted.

For landmark_00_local_dx the whole-window mean contrast is slightly negative (whole_window_z = -0.184) but the path is non-monotone: it rises to a positive peak near the middle of the window and then declines, with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches.

The landmark_00_local_dx trend is not well described by a low-degree polynomial (polynomial_accepted = false; relative_node_RMSE = 0.78), so a single stationary linear target is not supported by this curve.

The first-node and last-node rates for landmark_00_local_dx have opposite signs (first_rate_z = -17.5, last_rate_z = +8.1), indicating the local slope direction reverses within the observed window rather than holding one direction.

hypotheses.direction: time-dependent sign; no single global direction supported
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing a single stable sign with no sign changes and no strong sign conflicts across independent batches.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx curve over observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate contrast is time-varying within the observed window: it is positive in the middle of the window and negative near the window edges, so a fixed-sign coordinate reward over the whole window would be misaligned with the observed contrast at some times.

hypotheses.falsifier: Batch-resolved curves for this feature showing consistent sign within each batch and no strong sign conflicts.
hypotheses.statement: Because the landmark_00_local_dx path has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches, any temporal dose hypothesis keyed to this feature must be treated as uncertain and must be tested against batch-level variability rather than a single pooled mean.

limitations: Only one coordinate feature (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; other landmark coordinate features were not queried, so cross-feature consistency is unobserved.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves were used.
No descendant survival or decoded final affinity labels were observed, so selection preference here is association only and is not evidence of final benefit.
The curve is a coordinate proxy; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
